snippet.title: Big Bang (1995) full playthrough
snippet.description:
played on Arculator while watching a deadwing dork stream... decided to finally record this since I've beaten it about 3 times while dissecting the game. this is a shit run I'll admit it but its better to put it out now instead of stalling for another year.
For about two years I’ve been invested in the anomaly of Big Bang, a game made by Psycore back in the mid 90s.. its predecessor games were Top Banana and Revolver, all games found on the Acorn and DOS library. I however have my interest in Big Bang, mostly because no one has ever beaten it or done anything to archive this game. I’ll link a video about Top Banana since someone has beaten it. 
https://youtu.be/ZFKi4OdU5T0
As of the 2021 my friend Maddy tweaked the emulator for me and made a zip i can play, it’s been on and off of me playing it in my free time. This game is kinda fun and smart about the way it plays out.

Update, 8/20/26: I made a retrospective video, check my channel! 
For an in depth game guide, take a look at Gyrominiac’s fan site! I helped write some stuff, hooray! https://gyrominiac.nekoweb.org/bigbang.html
